checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Translucent washes, soft edges, paper texture, ink linework.
Clear stone cottage with slate roof, chimneys, door and windows.
Stream flows in front of and beside the cottage, with reflection.
Pale green hills rise behind the cottage.

faults.what: Slight perspective inconsistency in the reflection and the cottage's right side; minor.

summary: A charming square watercolour of a stone cottage beside a stream with soft green hills behind it, meeting every requirement with no text.
